description: Change the email address, handle or password of an account on the upstream PDS. Requires a service JWT (com.atproto.server.getServiceAuth) and account.admin. The change requires approval from a second administrator; with a single administrator in the workspace it executes directly. Passwords are sealed before an approval is stored and are never written to the audit trail.

password.description: New password. It is sealed with a key derived from the PDS administrator credential before an approval request is stored.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: The DID, email, handle or password are invalid, or no change was supplied.

errors.name: ApprovalRequired
errors.description: The action requires an approval request from another administrator.

errors.name: NotFound
errors.description: The account does not exist on the upstream PDS.

errors.name: NotConfigured
errors.description: The PDS administrator credential is not configured.

errors.name: UpstreamAuthFailed
errors.description: The PDS rejected the administrator credential.

errors.name: UpstreamUnavailable
errors.description: The PDS is unreachable or timed out.

errors.name: RateLimited
errors.description: The PDS rate limited the request.
